items.title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
items.summary: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching…
